passages.text: 2026 US list prices: KS-200 Temperature and Humidity Sensor, USD 189 per unit; KS-400 Particulate Sensor, USD 349 per unit.
Volume discounts: 5% off for orders of 50 to 199 units and 10% off for 200 units or more. Any discount above 10% requires approval from Sales Director Dana Whitcombe.
An extended warranty that adds 12 months of coverage is priced at 12% of the unit list price.
